newsitem.title: CHINA: China to refine 140 million tonnes oil in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China to refine 140 million tonnes oil in 1996.

text.p: China will refine 140 million tonnes of crude oil this year, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
China planned to boost its oil refining capacity to 200 million tonnes a year by 2000, and to 300-350 million tonnes by 2010, Xinhua said.

China also planned to set up several oil refineries, each with a capacity of 10 million tonnes a year, the agency said without giving details of when they would be brought on stream, where they would be located or the firms involved.
Also, ethylene production would hit three million tonnes in 1996, Xinhua said.

The opening of several new ethylene plants with an annual capacity of one million tonnes each would boost output to five million tonnes a year in 2000 and to 10 million tonnes in 2010, it said without elaborating
